summary: TransDigm Group filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, announcing completion of its acquisition of Prince Izant, formerly an Industrial Growth Partners portfolio company, for approximately $1.066 billion in cash, including certain tax benefits. The deal was previously announced July 27, 2026, and funded through cash on hand. Prince Izant designs brazing alloys and specialty metal components for aerospace/defense, aeroderivative turbine and transportation end markets, with majority aftermarket revenue and roughly 10,000 active SKUs. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch integration execution, purchase-price allocation of tax benefits, and leverage after cash-funded deal.
